Command replay (a class of call, not one reported incident)

Stop an agent trying to drop a MongoDB database

What happens

mongosh dropDatabase. The call below tries to drop a MongoDB database. The agent sends it through its Bash tool, and it involves MongoDB.

The call

mongosh --eval "db.dropDatabase()"

Tool: Bash. The replay uses placeholder tokens and hosts only.

Fix it without us

Give the agent a database user with the read role, or readWrite on one non-production database, and not dbOwner, root or another admin role. Take regular backups and test a restore.

What KYA does

Replay result: Stopped. In the replay test, the local hook denies the call and names the rule.

Rule mongo-drop-database, first stopped in version 0.35.0.

The hook is local and advisory. It fails open: if kya breaks or times out, the call goes ahead.

Install

For Claude Code, the host this replay ran on:

/plugin marketplace add The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya
/plugin install kya@shield-kya

For any host:

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
